messages:
Alex (People Ops): Quick FYI 0: We've updated the Manager Onboarding section of the handbook. New items: manager 30-day checklist, mandatory completion of the 'Inclusive onboarding' microcourse, and a manager attestation CSV for completed onboarding steps. Read: https://redwood.hr/handbook/manager-onboarding. Please submit a completed attestation for hires from May onwards by Tue 10/12.

Dana (Engineering Manager): Thanks. Does the 30-day checklist replace the old 60-day doc or sit alongside it?

Rita (People Ops): It replaces the old checklist for new managers and standardizes steps for the first 30 days. The 60-day guide remains as a supplemental reference for long-term ramp plans.

Cameron (Hiring Ops): We'll add a "manager_onboard_due" flag to offer packets for hires starting June to help managers hit the deadline.

hr-bot: Export queued: manager-onboard-roster-2601234000.csv -> s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/10/. ETA ~1m.

Eli (New Manager): If I onboard someone who starts part-time, do I mark them differently in the CSV?

Alex (People Ops): Yes — include the "part_time" flag and expected FTE in the notes column. The attestation accepts those fields.

Dana (Engineering Manager): Is the microcourse mandatory? I have back-to-back interviews this week and might be delayed.

Rita (People Ops): It is required for managers completing attestations. Microcourse is 18 min and auto-fills part of the CSV when completed: https://learn.redwood.com/courses/inclusive-onboarding. If you can't finish before the deadline, submit the attestation and mark "training_pending"; you'll get a follow-up.

Cameron (Hiring Ops): Uploaded a template CSV: columns = email,manager_id,start_date,part_time,checklist_complete,training_status,ack_submitted,notes. File path: s3://redwood-ops/exports/2026/10/manager-onboard-template-2601234000.csv

hr-bot: File ready for download.

Eli (New Manager): Submitted my attestation for 3 hires. Ack ID: MAN-ONB-260123-01. Left notes for one part-time start and one delayed training.

Alex (People Ops): Thanks Eli. Office hours Friday 11am PT for walkthrough and CSV help: https://meet.redwood.com/people-ops/manager-onboard (recording enabled). If you prefer bulk ingest, attach the filled CSV here or DM it to people-ops and we'll ingest.
thread_text_preview: Alex: manager onboarding handbook update. 30-day checklist + mandatory inclusive onboarding microcourse + attestation CSV. Export/template/office hours posted; managers submit attestations by Tue 10/12.
